name: Heavy Marbles Box
description: A box-state wrapper (inverse of Bubble Marbles). Heavy boxes release shelled marbles that plunge through the funnel, overtake everything in flight, and smash onto the belt first.
howToPlay: Tap boxes to drop marbles. Boxes marked with the metal emblem are Heavy: their shelled marbles fall much faster, pass marbles already in the funnel, and reach the conveyor first — then the shell shatters with a big bounce. Use them to rush a colour to the belt ahead of everything else.
author: Marble Sorter Prototyping

showcaseLevel.name: Heavy Marbles Box
showcaseLevel.desc: Rush a colour to the belt with Heavy boxes
